project.title: Analysis of protein of vesicles from hairy root of Salvia Sclarea
project.projectDescription: Proteome analysis of vesicles of hairy root of Salvia Sclarea by LC-HRMS/MS analysis
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Proteomic study: SDS-PAGE of vesicles of hairy root of Salvia Sclarea and liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrometry analysis of the peptides coming from tryptic digestion
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrometry analysis of the peptides coming fromtryptic digestion and analysis by bioinformatic tools as Mascot Distiller software followed by gene ontology determination of the identified proteins.
